dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped light-toned perimeters against a dark background. One prominent 'C' structure in the upper right displays a high-contrast jagged outer perimeter with a sharp gradient transition. A secondary 'O' structure in the center-right shows a more diffuse, pixelated light-to-dark interior gradient.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of small, high-intensity (near-white) pixel clusters located along the superior dorsal ridge. These clusters exhibit high core pixel concentration and lack internal gradients, appearing as localized specular highlights.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most distinct annuli on the posterior flank form an obtuse scalene triangle, where the longest side is approximately 1.5 times the length of the shortest side.

other_distinctive_markers: A complex reticulated pattern is present where the light perimeters of multiple annuli intersect, creating a tessellated or honeycomb-like topology on the mid-lateral surface.
